summary: AAON filed an 8-K reporting results of its annual meeting of stockholders held on May 12, 2026. Items included election of three directors; ratification of Grant Thornton as auditor for FY2026; advisory approval of executive compensation; approval of an annual frequency for say-on-pay votes; and approval of a charter amendment increasing the board size from nine to eleven directors. Additionally, the board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share payable June 26, 2026 to holders of record June 5, 2026. This filing contains routine corporate governance and dividend disclosure, no special situation event.
